summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the 4 requested Intercloud portal features: (1) Landing CMS split-view editor with live iframe preview, (2) Admin manual suspend/unsuspend, (3) Client termination request, (4) Admin review + reject/approve termination. All four feature flows PASS end-to-end via the public preview URL using the seeded admin & demo client accounts. Live preview iframe correctly reflects hero headline edits within ~2s; device mobile toggle changes iframe width to 390; language toggle & Save (with success msg 'Tersimpan - perubahan sudah live di landing page.') work; FAQ tab opens with an Add button. Admin suspend/unsuspend on service 6a6b056a176b95885ec6ff02 succeeded and status flipped ACTIVE->SUSPENDED->ACTIVE with lifecycle-msg 'Suspend berhasil (non-VM).' / 'Unsuspend berhasil (non-VM).' Client termination request created pending state with cancel option; admin banner surfaced the request; REJECT cleared the request block and kept service ACTIVE ('Reject terminate berhasil.'); after client re-request (via 'Ajukan lagi'), admin APPROVE flipped service status to TERMINATED with 'Approve terminate berhasil (non-VM).'

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking cms-device-tablet does not change the iframe width from the desktop value (700px stays 700px). Desktop and Tablet render identical width; only Mobile switches (to 390px). Likely the tablet breakpoint size is the same as, or larger than, the available preview column width (~700px), so the iframe max-width clamps it. Either shrink desktop preview, or set explicit tablet width (e.g. 768px) with horizontal scroll.
The re-request-after-rejected button ('Ajukan lagi', ClientServices.jsx line 527) has no data-testid, making it hard to automate. Add data-testid='terminate-rerequest-btn'.

Adding an FAQ works (FAQ tab counter changes to '(1)' after Tambah FAQ) but the individual FAQ item cards do not appear to use a data-testid pattern like 'cms-faq-item-*'. Test could not count items via testid. Consider adding data-testid='cms-faq-item-<idx>' plus 'cms-faq-remove-<idx>' for testability.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Fix tablet device preview width in AdminSiteContent so cms-device-tablet actually changes iframe width (e.g. width 768 with overflow-x auto).
(Optional/LOW) Add data-testid='terminate-rerequest-btn' to the 'Ajukan lagi' button in ClientServices.jsx TerminateRequestPanel (rejected state).
(Optional/LOW) Add data-testid to individual FAQ items in AdminSiteContent for easier automation.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSiteContent.jsx uses postMessage 'ic-cms-preview' + iframe with cmsPreview=1 - clean pattern; verified live update <2s.
ClientServices.jsx TerminateRequestPanel handles 3 states (pending/rejected/create) - good; only missing testid on re-request button.
Backend suspend/unsuspend/terminate messages returned localized Indonesian success strings - matches app language policy.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 4 requested flows pass; 3 LOW-priority testability/UI polish nits
